brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu characterized Qatar as a hostile state while rejecting accusations that his government maintains connections to the country, Al Jazeera English reported. Netanyahu described the allegations as "one big bluff," dismissing what critics had claimed about his administration's relationship with Doha.

The Israeli leader's sharp rhetoric underscores escalating tensions between the two nations. His comments come amid broader Middle Eastern diplomatic disputes and reflect deepening divides over regional security arrangements and political alliances. Netanyahu's characterization represents a stark public denunciation of Qatar's role in regional affairs and signals his government's stance toward the Gulf state.
dek: Israeli PM Benjamin Netanyahu has dismissed accusations about his government’s alleged ties to Qatar as ‘one big bluff’…
title: Netanyahu calls Qatar hostile state, dismisses ties allegations
